edge_finishing.coordinate_note: Selections are recorded in each construction frame before later mirror/rotation; repeated adjustment cases reuse the same predicates.

fastener_references.included: Twelve nominal M3 cover/rail/guide clamp sets plus the four existing stop envelopes
fastener_references.not_complete: Load-cell, NFC, indicator rear screws, threads, screw drives, cable ties and adhesive are not modeled

boot_access.opening: Dedicated angled BOOT bore in the closed USB wall; relocated board estimate
boot_access.button_position_evidence: Photo estimate only; verify actual board, cable and button before printing

indicator_fit.oled_fit: Provisional generic envelope; actual PCB, glass, pins and controller not identified. Winstar WEA012864D-03 gives 27.3 mm square, Joy-IT SBC-OLED01 gives 27 mm square; neither identifies the user board. No board hole pitch assumed.
indicator_fit.led_fit: 60 LEDs/m confirmed; 10 mm strip width and 5050 package provisional. Five-pixel cut length, coating and pads require measurement.
indicator_fit.attachment: Fixed front cover posts; two M3x16 replace front closure screws, four M2.5x10 plastic-thread prototype back screws.
indicator_fit.oled_retention: Edge pads and rear foam shims; no assumed PCB screw holes. Verify PCB/glass/headers before printing.
indicator_fit.wiring: 6 mm round fixed-base feedthrough at x=40,z=26; no wires to moving carrier.
indicator_fit.print_note: Fascia face down; long mounting bridge is elevated in that orientation and requires local support. Back flat down; bridge ceilings require slicer inspection.
